title: New every morning
caption: Every morning Zoya wakes up with a new name on Waypoint. Mira tells her story.
linkedin_text:
Most apps keep you as the same profile forever.

On Waypoint the app gives you a new generated name and avatar every day, and you can choose your own for the day if you like. Mira tells Zoya's story; every screen is the real app.

cast.zoya: Zoya, a young Indian woman in her twenties with a long braid, a teal kurta and round glasses

scenes.clip: Mira, a young woman with long dark hair in a lilac hoodie, facing the camera on a sunny rooftop at sunrise, soft golden light, a gentle smile.
scenes.vo: Hi, I'm Mira. This is Zoya's story. Every morning on Waypoint she wakes up with a new name.
scenes.sub: Hi, I'm Mira. This is Zoya's story. Every morning on Waypoint she wakes up with a new name.
scenes.title: New every morning

scenes.clip: {zoya} in a bright kitchen at sunrise holding a phone and a cup of tea, curious, steam rising, warm light.
scenes.vo: Yesterday was yesterday. This morning the app hands her a fresh start.
scenes.sub: Yesterday was yesterday. This morning the app hands her a fresh start.

scenes.clip: {zoya} at her kitchen counter looking at her phone with a delighted smile, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: It picks a name and an avatar for her, and it resets tomorrow.
scenes.sub: It picks a name and an avatar for her, and it resets tomorrow.

scenes.clip: {zoya} thoughtfully picking on her phone at a sunny window, tea beside her, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: If she likes, she can choose her own name and avatar for the day.
scenes.sub: If she likes, she can choose her own name and avatar for the day.

scenes.clip: {zoya} laughing with a friend over coffee at a sunny cafe table, relaxed, warm morning light.
scenes.vo: Same Zoya. A different name. And a lighter start.
scenes.sub: Same Zoya. A different name. And a lighter start.

scenes.clip: {zoya} walking to work through a sunny street, a bag on her shoulder, an easy confident smile.
scenes.vo: Say today's sentence. Let the name change tomorrow.
scenes.sub: Say today's sentence. Let the name change tomorrow.

scenes.vo: Waypoint. Say it once. Free on Google Play, in many Indian and international languages.
